raw_material_verification.extraction_policy: Regular files extracted using tar data filter; symbolic links retained in archive and manifest without creating external links on Windows.

baseline_replay.interpretation: Frozen real trajectories; diagnostic server performance, not E2E quality.

reference_freeze.interpretation: Freeze only from all three original-deployment repetitions. Every earlier strict screen result stays unchanged. Baseline self-consistency is not an independent acceptance result. Future candidates must pass both per-task extrema/effective-rate and per-task mean bounds on fresh runs, with run uncertainty reported separately.

runtime_failure_case.denominators: All terminal tasks stay in effective throughput and original end-to-end F1 summaries. Conditional model/tool means exclude typed infrastructure failures only; actual model, finish and tool failures remain. Candidates must have zero infrastructure failures.

report_limits.stage_measurement_limit: Unmodified original deployment does not export the later digest/context stage fields. No zeros or synthetic stage chart are substituted; baseline timeline evidence is in the real Nsight traces.
report_limits.interpretation: Three independent engine measurements per condition. All complete poor-quality and infrastructure-failed cases retained. Missing r2 conditions are later supplements, not replacements; no adjacent wall-time pairing is claimed. Raw QoS values keep every failure; typed runtime classification is corrected in derived statistics.

reproduction.note: Historical scripts use frozen absolute run paths and exclusive output creation. Reproduce into a fresh run directory; preserve original artifacts. Source statistics and all raw records are included in the verified material bundle.
